# Part II Review {.unnumbered #part-2-review}

These ten questions connect ideas from Chapters 8–15. Use the assumptions given in each question and choose the one best answer. Work through the complete set before checking the explanations.

## Transfer exercise

Two recruiting panels use the same screen in pools with different base rates. Describe which comparison would test the reliability of a quick impression, then identify the denominator needed to update a positive result.
